# Hypothesis: H14 | I've been exploring movement rules for too many actions without solving the level. The board changes even when squares don't move, suggesting there's another mechanic. SPACE is a valid action I haven't tried. Let me try SPACE to see what it does.

if last_transition is not None:

    after_seg = last_transition.after_frame.segmentation
    
    before_nodes = {n['hash']: n for n in before_seg['nodes']}
    after_nodes = {n['hash']: n for n in after_seg['nodes']}
    
    print("Before RIGHT node colors and counts:")
    from collections import Counter
    before_colors = Counter(n['color'] for n in before_seg['nodes'])
    after_colors = Counter(n['color'] for n in after_seg['nodes'])
    print(f"  Before: {dict(before_colors)}")
    print(f"  After:  {dict(after_colors)}")
    
    # Check for any color/pixel count changes
    for n in after_seg['nodes']:
        if n['hash'] in before_nodes:
            bn = before_nodes[n['hash']]
            if bn['pixels'] != n['pixels']:
                print(f"  Node hash {n['hash']} color {n['color']}: pixels {bn['pixels']} -> {n['pixels']}")

# Try SPACE

    print(f"  boundary={n['boundary']}")

# Check all node colors

print(f"All colors: {dict(all_colors)}")
